title: AI ‘Chipflation’ Washes Ashore in the UK Economy
excerpt: UK consumer prices will grab headlines in the coming week, with an AI-driven memory-chip shortage and higher energy costs keeping the Bank of England on guar...
content_html:
Irina Anghel

Sat, August 15, 2026 at 3:00 PM CDT 9 min read

(Bloomberg) -- UK consumer prices will grab headlines in the coming week, with an AI-driven memory-chip shortage and higher energy costs keeping the Bank of England on guard.

Most Read from Bloomberg

  • Anthropic Revenue Surges to Over $11.5 Billion in Second Quarter

  • US Readies Unprecedented 'Economic Isolation' Plan for Iran

  • Selena Gomez Accused of Fraud by Mental-Health Startup Investors

  • Costliest US Bond Sale Since 2001 Is Investor Warning to Bessent

  • OpenAI's Annualized Revenue Tops $40 Billion Ahead of IPO

Data on Wednesday are set to show inflation accelerating for the first time in four months, with the median economist estimate in a Bloomberg survey predicting a 2.9% jump in July. The Iran war is making plane travel more expensive and feeding through to household energy bills, while a crunch in artificial intelligence-related components drives up electronics prices.

It's the start of a lift-off expected to continue through the second half, cutting short a spell of positive news on price pressures. The figures may leave BOE rate-setters increasingly uneasy as the Iran war starts to show up more clearly in prices — especially with a resilient economy.

One of three dissenters at the BOE's last meeting, Chief Economist Huw Pill doubled down on his call for tighter rates after the UK economy unexpectedly grew in June, helped by a heat wave and the World Cup.

And while much of the inflation outlook depends on developments in the Middle East, AI is emerging as a potential dark horse.

The BOE has warned that the rapid expansion of AI capacity is driving up the cost of memory chips used in phones, laptops and games consoles, while the British Retail Consortium's July data suggest rising chip costs are feeding through to electronics prices. Apple laptops and tablets as well as Xbox gaming consoles are already set to get more expensive, a sign that AI pressures could become a feature of core goods inflation in the coming months.

What Bloomberg Economics Says:

"The UK inflation story this year has had two key themes: Domestically generated cost pressures have continued to moderate, while external forces – specifically energy — have pushed in the other direction, keeping the headline rate from falling close to the 2% inflation target. July's CPI data should reinforce the trend: We expect inflation to jump thanks to a sharp rise in household energy bills. The move reflects the reset of the quarterly price cap by Ofgem, the UK energy regulator."

—Dan Hanson, Ana Andrade and Matt Bunny. For full analysis, click here

伊琳娜·安赫尔

2026 年 8 月 15 日星期六下午 3:00 CDT 阅读时间 9 分钟

（彭博社）——英国消费者价格将在未来一周成为头条新闻，人工智能驱动的存储芯片短缺和能源成本上升让英国央行保持警惕。

大多数阅读来自彭博社

  • Anthropic 第二季度收入飙升至 115 亿美元以上
  • 美国准备对伊朗实施前所未有的“经济孤立”计划
  • 赛琳娜·戈麦斯 (Selena Gomez) 被心理健康初创公司投资者指控欺诈
  • 2001年以来最昂贵的美国债券发行警告投资者要警惕
  • OpenAI IPO 前年收入突破 400 亿美元

周三的数据将显示通胀四个月来首次加速，彭博社调查中经济学家的预估中位数预计 7 月份通胀将上涨 2.9%。 伊朗战争使飞机旅行变得更加昂贵，并影响了家庭能源账单，而人工智能相关零部件的短缺推高了电子产品价格。

这是预计将持续到下半年的上涨的开始，从而缩短了价格压力方面的利好消息。 随着伊朗战争开始更明显地反映在价格上——尤其是在经济富有弹性的情况下，这些数据可能会让英国央行利率制定者越来越不安。

英国央行上次会议上的三名反对者之一，首席经济学家休·皮尔 (Huw Pill) 在热浪和世界杯的推动下，6 月份英国经济意外增长后，加倍呼吁收紧利率。

尽管通胀前景在很大程度上取决于中东的事态发展，但人工智能正在成为潜在的黑马。

英国央行警告称，人工智能产能的快速扩张正在推高手机、笔记本电脑和游戏机中使用的存储芯片的成本，而英国零售协会 7 月份的数据表明，芯片成本的上涨正在影响电子产品价格。 苹果笔记本电脑、平板电脑以及 Xbox 游戏机的价格已经上涨，这表明人工智能压力可能成为未来几个月核心商品通胀的一个特征。

彭博经济研究院的观点是：

“今年英国的通胀故事有两个关键主题：国内产生的成本压力持续缓和，而外部力量——特别是能源——则朝另一个方向推动，使整体利率不致跌至接近2%的通胀目标。 7 月份的 CPI 数据应该会强化这一趋势：我们预计，由于家庭能源费用大幅上涨，通胀将大幅上升。 此举反映了英国能源监管机构 Ofgem 对季度价格上限的重置。”

——丹·汉森、安娜·安德拉德和马特·邦尼。 如需完整分析，请点击此处
